;Disasters and accidents
*[[2018 lower Puna eruption]]
**Several more properties are destroyed as [[Kīlauea]] continues to erupt. [http://www.newsweek.com/kilauea-hawaii-volcano-lava-flows-destroy-more-buildings-residents-flee-945748 (''Newsweek'')]
*[[2018 North Indian Ocean cyclone season]]
**[[Cyclone Mekunu]] makes landfall near [[Salalah]], [[Oman]], killing at least five people with 30 others reported missing. According to the [[India Meteorological Department]] (IMD), maximum sustained winds of {{convert|170|-|180|km/h|sigfig=3}} have been recorded, equivalent to a [[Saffir–Simpson scale#Category 3|Category 3]] hurricane. The storm is moving north toward [[Saudi Arabia]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/weather/topstories/powerful-cyclone-lashes-oman-yemen-5-dead-30-missing/ar-AAxLKpR (AP via MSN)] [http://www.rsmcnewdelhi.imd.gov.in/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=9&Itemid=141&lang=en (IMD)] 
*[[2018 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[List of governors of Alabama|Alabama Governor]] [[Kay Ivey]], [[List of governors of Florida|Florida Governor]] [[Rick Scott]], and [[List of governors of Mississippi|Mississippi Governor]] [[Phil Bryant]] each declare a state of emergency as [[2018 Atlantic hurricane season#Subtropical Storm Alberto|Subtropical Storm Alberto]], with maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (65 km/h), approaches the [[Southeastern United States]]. The [[National Hurricane Center]] predicts the storm will make [[landfall]] over the [[Gulf Coast of the United States|northern Gulf Coast]] late Monday afternoon or Monday night, with heavy rainfall and tropical storm conditions preceding actual landfall. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation-now/2018/05/26/subtropical-storm-alberto-florida-state-emergency/647257002/ (''USA Today'')] [https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/text/refresh/MIATCPAT1+shtml/270532.shtml (National Hurricane Center)]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**[[South Korea]]n [[President of South Korea|President]] [[Moon Jae-in]] meets with [[North Korea]]n leader [[Kim Jong-un]] the second time in recent months at the peace village on the Northern side to discuss the topic of the [[2018 North Korea–United States summit|June 12 summit]] in [[Singapore]] between the U.S. and North Korea, which was cancelled then left with the possibility of happening the day after. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/south-korean-president-met-north-korea-s-kim-jong-un-saturday-10280606 (Channel News Asia)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-44265287 (BBC)]
*[[United States–Venezuela relations]] 
**Josh Holt, an American held in Venezuela for allegedly stockpiling weapons and attempting to destabilize the government, is released to the United States. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/05/26/politics/trump-josh-holt-venezuela-freed/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2017–18 Qatar diplomatic crisis]]
**[[Qatar]] orders its traders and shops to stop dealing in products imported from [[Saudi Arabia]], the [[United Arab Emirates]], [[Egypt]] and [[Bahrain]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-gulf-qatar-goods/qatar-bans-goods-from-uae-saudi-as-embargo-anniversary-approaches-idUSKCN1IS06V (Reuters)] 

;Law and crime
*[[Reactions to Innocence of Muslims|Reactions to ''Innocence of Muslims'']]
**[[Egypt]]'s top administrative court upholds a 2013 lower court ruling on the short film ''[[Innocence of Muslims]]''. The court orders authorities to block [[YouTube]] for a month. An official says the movie denigrates [[Islam]]'s prophet [[Muhammad]]. [https://www.rappler.com/technology/news/203443-egypt-orders-youtube-block-over-islam-film (AFP via Rappler)] [http://www.egypttoday.com/Article/1/50938/Court-rule-banning-YouTube-in-Egypt-for-one-month (''Egypt Today'')]

;Politics and elections
*[[Amendments to the Constitution of Ireland]]
**[[Republic of Ireland|Irish]] citizens vote in a [[Elections in the Republic of Ireland#Referendums|referendum]] on the proposed [[Thirty-sixth Amendment of the Constitution Bill 2018]] to repeal the 1983 [[Eighth Amendment of the Constitution of Ireland|Eighth Amendment]] [[Constitution of Ireland|constitutional]] ban on [[abortion]] by 66.4% to 33.6%. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-44256152 (BBC)]

;Sports
*[[2017–18 UEFA Champions League]]
**[[Liverpool F.C.]] and defending champions [[Real Madrid C.F.]] face each other in the [[2018 UEFA Champions League Final|final]] in [[Kiev]], [[Ukraine]]. Winning 3–1, Real Madrid are European champions for the 13th time and is the first team since [[FC Bayern Munich]] in the 1970s to win three titles in a row. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2018/may/26/real-madrid-v-liverpool-champions-league-final-2018-live (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2018 Hypo-Meeting]]
**World and Olympic champion [[Nafissatou Thiam]] becomes the first female [[heptathlete]] ever to [[High jump|jump]] over {{convert|2|m}}. In this year's [[heptathlon]] event at the [[Götzis]], [[Austria]], competition, she clears the bar at 2.01 m, also a season's best in women's high jump overall. [https://www.iaaf.org/news/report/thiam-and-warner-the-overnight-leaders-in-got (IAAF)]
